description.value: Eleni's Greek Restaurant is a family-owned establishment in Downtown Mission serving a broad menu of Greek specialties alongside pasta, seafood, chicken, veal, steaks, and burgers. It has built a local reputation for generous platters, attentive service, and a welcoming atmosphere. A touring cyclist passing through the Fraser Valley would find it a solid sit-down meal option in the heart of Mission's main street.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 63m; stands (2 spaces) at 73m; stands (2 spaces) at 77m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM and website confirm the same business name and phone number (604-826-4430). The website provides a physical address—33262 1st Ave, Mission, B.C.—absent from the OSM record, and testimonials consistently reference 'Downtown Mission,' while the OSM community field says 'Chilliwack'; the lat/lon (~49.13N, ~122.30W) aligns with Mission, not Chilliwack. Takeout is confirmed by a customer testimonial; no evidence exists for any cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chilliwack' but the website address and all customer testimonials place this business in Mission, B.C. The lat/lon coordinates (~49.13N, ~122.30W) also align with Mission, not Chilliwack. The community tag in OSM appears to be incorrect.
OSM address field is empty; address '33262 1st Ave Mission, B.C.' was sourced from the website footer only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active sit-down and takeout restaurant in Mission's downtown core with a broad menu; suitable as a meal stop for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley.
